why_chosen: Singapore-headquartered, US-listed super-app with a large local engineering organisation, a well-documented layoff history, and plentiful public salary and interview data; a plausible target for a mid-level software, data or product job seeker in Singapore.

identity.summary: Real listed company (NASDAQ: GRAB), Singapore-based, founded 2012, CEO Anthony Tan. Legal entity of the Singapore employer not confirmed.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced the official press release and a major newspaper; extraction of both worked and returned clean text.
identity.what_was_missing: Registry data (ACRA) and incorporation details of the holding company.

business_and_headcount.summary: Rides, deliveries, financial services across eight SEA countries; 57M monthly transacting users in Q3 2026. Headcount only from third-party directory estimates (about 56K to 58K), not company-reported.
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Gave business scope and user numbers from official sources.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: Company-reported headcount; the two aggregator pages that would give it (financecharts, stockanalysis) failed to extract; a targeted 20-F search drifted to irrelevant results.

financial_performance.summary: First full-year net profit in 2025; Q3 2026 revenue US$1,112M (+27%), adjusted EBITDA US$237M, profit US$18M, guidance raised. Sources disagree on exact FY2025 profit (US$200M vs US$268M).
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Many primary and press sources in one search; official release extracted in full.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Reconciliation of conflicting profit figures; funding history.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: June 2023 cut of 1,000 jobs (11%); Seattle office reportedly closed; five-day return to office from Dec 2024. No 2025-2026 layoff information found.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: A simpler retry query returned a good mix of news and a layoff tracker; articles extracted well.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Anything after 2025; the first, longer query timed out.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Only rating numbers from search snippets (Glassdoor SG work-life balance 3.4/5, compensation 3.9/5). Review pages not read; Reddit thread blocked by a bot challenge.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Search found the right review pages and the snippets carried headline ratings.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Actual review text, management feedback, turnover; Glassdoor extract failed and Reddit returned a challenge page.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Levels.fyi Singapore SWE total comp about S$10K to S$27K/month by level, median S$16K/month, RSUs vest over 4 years; other sources conflict (Glassdoor S$80K to 118K/year). Benefits detail missing.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Several salary sites surfaced in one search and Levels.fyi extracted with its table.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Level labels were dropped in extraction so the mid-level mapping is inferred; benefits (leave, insurance, bonus policy) not found.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Taro summary of 43 Singapore SWE interviews: very selective, deep system-design-style panels, mixed sentiment. Glassdoor and Dataford pages found but not read.
interview_and_hiring.how_openserp_helped: Search returned interview-specific pages; Taro extracted cleanly.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Round-by-round process, timelines, offer outcomes; only one interview page read in full.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: Grab warns of scammers impersonating staff and offering fake jobs; police advisory on task scams (general). No Grab-specific fines or legal actions surfaced, but the query returned mostly generic scam pages.
red_flags_and_scams.how_openserp_helped: Surfaced official government and company scam advisories.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: Regulatory or legal history; absence of trouble cannot be proven from these results.

recent_news.summary: Q3 2026 results (Nov 3, 2026), raised guidance, buyback; Q2 2026 results with a new buyback; Stash Financial acquisition (Feb 2026).
recent_news.how_openserp_helped: Very good freshness: results from four days earlier were returned with correct dates.
recent_news.what_was_missing: Independent news coverage of the Q3 results and any non-financial news (products, regulation).

blocked_or_unreadable_sites: reddit.com (HTTP 200 but only a 'Prove your humanity' bot-challenge page; not retried)
one bing search timed out (504); retried with a simpler query
misleading_or_wrong_results: Final headcount query (20-F, full-time employees) returned off-topic results including heavy.com sports and pcworld.com
Reddit extract returned HTTP 200 but only a bot-challenge page
Extracted Levels.fyi table lost its level labels
Conflicting FY2025 profit figures across Grab, Straits Times and SBR (unreconciled)

verdict.reasoning: OpenSERP found current, dated, primary and press sources on finances, layoffs, news and pay ranges, enough for a credible bottom line. It was weak on the human side (reviews, culture), where the best sites blocked extraction, and searches were slow (20 to 37 seconds each). A job seeker should treat sentiment and headcount as unverified and corroborate with the employer directly.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Level and total-compensation breakdown in the offer letter
Visa and relocation terms if applicable
Confirmation of the employing entity and contract terms
